original_abstract.text: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. Without the use of custom kernels, our approach reduces end-to-end latency by up to 25x over vLLM on Ascend NPUs, and achieves generation latency comparable to a SOTA solution using custom kernels, showing that the generation pipeline should be optimized holistically before resorting to custom kernel development.
original_abstract.source_title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference

en.text: This work optimizes wide-beam generative recommendation as a complete inference pipeline. Tree attention shares prompt KV access across beams; precomputed masks, static cache allocation, unrolled dispatch, graph compilation and constrained decoding reduce runtime overhead. Without custom kernels, experiments on Ascend NPUs report up to 25x lower end-to-end latency than vLLM and latency comparable to a specialized-kernel solution. The result motivates evaluating scheduling and shared-context reuse before adding kernel complexity; the reported speedup is hardware- and baseline-specific.

zh.text: 这项工作把宽束生成式推荐的解码流程整体优化：树状注意力让多条候选路径共享提示词的键值缓存访问，再用预生成掩码、静态缓存、展开调度、图编译和受限解码减少运行时开销。在昇腾 NPU 上，无需自定义算子，端到端延迟相对 vLLM 最高缩短 25 倍，并接近专用算子方案。可借鉴的是先检查调度和共享上下文复用；倍数只适用于论文的硬件与基线。

original_abstract.text: Multimodal generative recommendation with discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs) requires distinguishing historical modalities that merely alter token predictions from those that genuinely reduce catalog-level ambiguity. When audiovisual, visual, or textual streams are missing, degraded, or semantically conflicting, uniform fusion and unconstrained token gates can propagate misleading content across iterative denoising steps. We propose CONCORD-Rec, a reliability-conditioned discrete diffusion recommender supervised by counterfactual catalog-partition utility. Given a fixed tokenizer and a partially masked SID state, CONCORD-Rec evaluates out-of-fold teacher coalitions over the exact feasible catalog support and aggregates item posteriors across the target code partition at each unresolved position. Rather than distilling raw token probabilities directly, the resulting counterfactual loss differences supervise an availability-masked tokenwise gate that allocates bounded modality residuals around a behavioral denoiser while retaining an exact behavioral fallback slot. We establish theoretical fixed-support ranking stability bounds under gate perturbations and evaluate position-level and code-conditional allocation across audiovisual and image-text recommendation benchmarks under controlled missingness, signal degradation, and semantic conflict. Across 20 source-compatible protocol-dataset rows, CONCORD-Rec improves NDCG by 4%; under matched 30% conflict it improves NDCG by 14.63%. The full-vs-uniform-T=16 sweep improves quality by 2.00-3.58% while reducing p95 latency by up to 86.89%.
original_abstract.source_title: CONCORD-Rec: Catalog-Conditioned Modality Utility for Semantic-ID Diffusion Recommendation

en.text: CONCORD-Rec uses counterfactual utility over feasible catalog partitions to supervise modality gates in a semantic-ID diffusion recommender. Bounded modality residuals augment a behavioral denoiser, with an explicit behavioral fallback when content is unreliable. The abstract reports ranking improvements under missing, degraded and conflicting modalities, plus quality-latency gains in a controlled decoding sweep. For scalable recommendation, the useful idea is to allocate multimodal information by its contribution to candidate discrimination rather than by token changes alone.

zh.text: CONCORD-Rec 在语义 ID 扩散推荐中，用反事实比较衡量各模态能否帮助区分有效候选，并据此训练模态门控。内容信号只作有界补充，不可靠时可退回行为模型。摘要报告了模态缺失、退化和冲突条件下的排序改善，以及受控解码实验中的质量与延迟收益。可借鉴的是按候选区分能力分配多模态信息，而不只看词元预测是否变化。

original_abstract.text: Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA) is a recurrent sequence mixer that combines learned nonlinear features with covariance-guided memory updates. It stores associations through recursive ridge regression, using correlations among past keys to determine how new observations modify memory. A content-dependent Ornstein--Uhlenbeck transition controls retention and restores uncertainty for future writes. This construction admits an exact temporal-kernel interpretation and maintains an inference state whose size is independent of context length. Associative block maps and explicit adjoints support parallel training while preserving the recursive update. In controlled language-modeling experiments, KRA improves prediction quality over attention and recurrent baselines, strengthens natural associative recall over the evaluated recurrent models, and achieves practical distributed training throughput. These properties provide a principled foundation for nonlinear, adaptive sequence memory.
original_abstract.source_title: Kernel Ridge Attention: Nonlinear Memory with Selective Forgetting

en.text: Kernel Ridge Attention stores nonlinear associations through recursive ridge regression, using past-key covariance to guide updates and a content-dependent retention process to selectively forget. Its inference state is independent of context length, while associative block maps enable parallel training. Controlled language-model experiments report stronger prediction and associative recall than the evaluated baselines with practical distributed throughput. It suggests a fixed-memory sequence mixer worth testing for long user histories; CTR performance has not been demonstrated.

zh.text: Kernel Ridge Attention 用递归岭回归保存非线性关联，由历史键的协方差决定如何写入，并按内容选择保留或遗忘。推理状态大小不随上下文长度增长，分块组合则支持并行训练。受控语言模型实验报告了预测质量、关联召回和分布式吞吐表现。它提供了一种适合探索长用户历史的固定容量记忆结构，尚未验证 CTR 收益。

original_abstract.text:
Modern industrial recommender systems use multi-stage cascades--retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking--to narrow millions of candidates to a personalized list. While each stage deploys sophisticated models, pipeline-level decisions on channel activation, quotas, model selection, and score fusion remain engineer-tuned and user-agnostic within each scenario.
  This report presents MARS (Multi-stage Agentic Recommendation System), extending personalization from individual-stage predictions to full pipeline orchestration. A near-line agent built on fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B generates per-user configurations--a seven-dimensional action covering pipeline mode, retrieval quotas, model selection, fusion weights, and reranker settings--from a constrained action space. Configurations are validated, cached, and consumed asynchronously; the cascade never waits for LLM inference. Schema checks, fallbacks, and a kill switch ensure serving safety.
  The policy is trained in three stages: Confidence-aware SFT distills schema-valid generation from a teacher model; Format-Anchored Preference Optimization (FAPO) learns action preferences via ActionMask with posterior weighting; Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refines the policy through Sandbox replay with a frozen reward model, without exposing exploratory actions to live traffic.
  Two-week A/B tests across five Taobao scenarios with over ten million daily users show positive gains on all key metrics. The largest reach +5.22% V2P and +7.34% GMV, with positive CTR lifts on both click surfaces. About 20% of requests use a lightweight Minimal mode, and deployment shows 12 ms lower mean serving latency versus production.

en.text: MARS uses a near-line Qwen3-0.6B agent to choose per-user retrieval quotas, pipeline modes, models, fusion weights and reranking settings. Validated configurations are cached and consumed asynchronously, keeping agent inference off the online critical path. Supervised distillation, preference optimization and sandbox policy training support the agent. Two-week tests across five Taobao scenarios report positive business metrics and 12 ms lower mean serving latency. The CTR-scaling lesson is to allocate pipeline compute per user while preserving validation and fallback paths.

zh.text: MARS 用近线 Qwen3-0.6B 智能体为用户选择召回配额、流水线模式、模型、融合权重和重排设置。配置经校验后缓存并异步使用，在线请求无需等待智能体推理；训练结合监督蒸馏、偏好优化和沙箱策略训练。五个淘宝场景的两周实验报告了业务指标改善和平均服务延迟降低 12 毫秒。可借鉴的是按用户分配整条推荐链路的计算预算，并保留校验与回退路径。

original_abstract.text: Accurate click-through rate (CTR) prediction depends on user representations that capture both persistent preferences and recent intent, yet processing extensive behavioral histories for every ranking request is costly under production compute and latency constraints. We present X-split ARGUS, a framework for ad ranking whose history compressor and online ranker are trained end to end. The compressor encodes past interactions into a compact set of tokens that are computed offline and reused across candidates, while the online ranker scores ads through cross-attention to these tokens and representations of recent events. Training combines an autoregressive loss for click feedback with distillation of candidate-specific click logits from a larger teacher that scores each candidate using the uncompressed history. The number of compressed history tokens and the length of recent history can be adjusted to fit serving compute and latency budgets. Offline evaluation shows a 0.81% relative reduction in normalized entropy (NE) compared with the production baseline. Deployment in a large-scale real-time bidding system increases online inference cost by 15% relative to the production baseline. An online A/B test against this baseline yields relative gains of 4.65% in a business metric reflecting the monetary value of conversions generated for advertisers and 2.96% in clicks.
original_abstract.source_title: X-split Argus: Learning Reusable History Tokens for Efficient CTR Prediction

en.text: X-split ARGUS jointly trains an offline history compressor and an online ad ranker. Reusable history tokens are combined with recent events through cross-attention, with click-feedback supervision and distillation from a teacher using uncompressed history. The abstract reports a 0.81% relative normalized-entropy reduction, 4.65% improvement in advertiser conversion value, and 2.96% more clicks versus production, alongside 15% higher online inference cost. It offers a concrete history-capacity and serving-budget trade-off for CTR scaling.

zh.text: X-split ARGUS 联合训练离线历史压缩器和在线广告排序器，把长期行为压成可跨候选复用的词元，再与近期行为做交叉注意力。训练结合点击监督和未压缩历史教师的蒸馏。相对生产基线，摘要报告归一化熵降低 0.81%、广告主转化价值指标提升 4.65%、点击数提升 2.96%，同时在线推理成本增加 15%。它提供了在历史容量与服务预算之间取舍的具体方案。
